name: co2-ppm
title: CO2 PPM - Trends in Atmospheric Carbon Dioxide (Mauna Loa, monthly)
description: Monthly mean atmospheric carbon dioxide (CO2) at Mauna Loa Observatory, Hawaii, from March 1958 to July 2026, as dry-air mole fraction in parts per million (ppm). Published by the NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory (GML). March 1958 to April 1974 is C. David Keeling's Scripps Institution of Oceanography (SIO) record; NOAA measurements start in May 1974. Monthly values are corrected to the centre of the month based on the average seasonal cycle, and missing months are interpolated. After the Mauna Loa eruption, measurements came from the Maunakea Observatories (about 21 miles north) from December 2022 to 4 July 2023 (see the `site` column). Snapshot of the NOAA file retrieved 2026-08-30 (file created 2026-08-05). NOAA GML asks users to give credit for the data and to contact the data providers (Xin Lan, xin.lan@noaa.gov) where the data are central to a publication.

resources.name: co2-mm-mlo
resources.title: Monthly mean CO2 at Mauna Loa
resources.description: One row per month, March 1958 to July 2026, with no gaps. Built from archive/co2_mm_mlo.csv by build.ts. The source's sentinel values (ndays -1, sdev -9.99, unc -0.99, and an unc of 0.00 next to a missing sdev) are empty cells here.

fields.name: decimal_date
fields.description: Centre of the month as a decimal year, as given by NOAA (source `decimal date`).

fields.name: co2_ppm
fields.description: Monthly mean CO2 dry-air mole fraction, ppm, corrected to the centre of the month. Interpolated where `interpolated` is true (and possibly in SIO months, which are not flagged). Source `average`.

fields.name: co2_deseasonalized_ppm
fields.description: Monthly mean CO2 with the average seasonal cycle removed, ppm. Source `deseasonalized`.

fields.name: days_measured
fields.description: Number of days with valid daily means in the month. Empty for SIO months (no information) and interpolated months. Source `ndays`.

fields.name: daily_sdev_ppm
fields.description: Standard deviation of the daily means within the month, ppm. Empty where the source has none. Source `sdev`.

fields.name: uncertainty_ppm
fields.description: Uncertainty of the monthly mean, ppm. Empty where the source has none (negative sentinel, or 0.00 where sdev is also missing). Source `unc`.

fields.name: interpolated
fields.description: true if NOAA interpolated the month (source ndays negative), false if measured. Empty for SIO months (March 1958 to April 1974), which the source does not flag.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: Who made the measurement: SIO (Scripps, March 1958 to April 1974) or NOAA (from May 1974).

fields.name: site
fields.description: Where the measurements were made: Mauna Loa; Maunakea (December 2022 to June 2023, Mauna Loa closed by the eruption); or Maunakea and Mauna Loa (July 2023: Maunakea to 4 July, Mauna Loa after).
